title: Day 19 — Event Bus (pub/sub)
prompt: This event bus has two bugs: a handler that unsubscribes another during an emit causes that other handler to be skipped, and once() fires on every emit instead of just once. How would you fix it?

clarifications.answer: Right — emit iterates the live listener array, so a handler calling off() mid-loop shifts the array and skips the next handler. Iterate a snapshot instead.
Yes: dispatch over a copy of the listeners captured at the start of emit, so subscribe/unsubscribe during the emit doesn't change who runs this round.
once() should fire the handler at most once and then remove itself. It should also return an unsubscribe so it can be cancelled before firing.
Snapshot semantics: only handlers subscribed at the START of the emit are called; a handler added during the emit is not called until the next emit.
Assume handlers don't throw for this exercise — focus on the iteration and once bugs.

hints: Why does removing an element from an array you're iterating with for..of skip the next one?
emit: iterate over [...arr] (a copy), not the live array.
once: const off = this.on(event, (p) => { off(); handler(p); }); return off;
